description: Progress toward a number (a record, a goal): a bar from start to target with the current value marked and the gap called out.

fields.title: Title. *word* = accent color
fields.value_label: Who/what the current number is, e.g. Klay Thompson
fields.target_label: Who/what the target is, e.g. Ray Allen (3rd all-time)
fields.start: Where the bar starts (default 0). Raise it to zoom in on a small gap; the start number is printed on the bar so it stays honest.
fields.gap_label: Text for the gap (default: '<difference> to go')
fields.footer: Optional small line at the bottom
